newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply two trln won to money mkt.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply two trln won to money mkt.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said on Monday it would supply two trillion won this week to the South Korean money market to meet rising cash demand before and around the Lunar New Year holidays which fall on February 7-9.
The central bank said 1.2 trillion won would be supplied through buying back Monetary Stabilisation Bonds before maturity and 800 billion won through repurchase agreements.
The central bank has already released a total of 3.6 trillion won through similar arrangements since Hanbo Steel Co was declared insolvent on January 23.
"There will be enough money in the market to meet demand for the holidays," a bank official said.
